name: Mandakini House
description: Mandakini river emerges from Chorabari Glacier near Kedarnath in Uttarakhand. The river merges with Kaliganga near Kalimath temple and with Madhyamaheshwar Ganga near Ukhimath. The Mandakini is mentioned as one of the transcendental rivers in the holy religious work Srimad Bhagavatam.
